name: Bifeprunox
summary: Bifeprunox (INN; code name DU-127,090) is an atypical antipsychotic which, similarly to aripiprazole, combines minimal D2 receptor agonism with serotonin receptor agonism. It was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia, psychosis, and Parkinson's disease.

pharmacology.text: Bifeprunox is an atypical antipsychotic that is a partial D2 agonist.

uses.text: It was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia, psychosis, and Parkinson's disease.
